rule: No legacy provider/resource/credential is carried into the rebuild unless an audited capability is still required and the new architecture cannot replace it more simply.

decisions.legacy_implementation: Cloudflare Worker + D1 + Durable Object + static assets + scheduled maintenance
decisions.new_requirement: Primary realtime authority, durable operational DB, group realtime, outbox
decisions.new_resource: New Worker + new D1 + new Durable Object namespace/class
decisions.notes: Workers Scripts Write also covers script deploy/settings/secrets/tail and account-level Worker Custom Domain APIs used by the old implementation.

decisions.new_requirement: Fail before project exceeds target 50% of free allocation
decisions.new_resource: Quota guard querying Cloudflare analytics for only registered project resources
decisions.notes: D1 rowsRead/rowsWritten/databaseSizeBytes are available via GraphQL analytics; this permission is justified by the explicit <=50% quota requirement.

decisions.legacy_implementation: Account-level /accounts/{account}/workers/domains API; no Zone ID in the implementation
decisions.new_requirement: Bind vanhanhdchungyen.cc.cd when DNS/zone authority is actually available
decisions.notes: Do not overgrant zone permissions. workers.dev is the bootstrap endpoint until the hostname is attachable.

decisions.legacy_implementation: Beta used direct Google OAuth + Sheets API; Stable used GAS bridge
decisions.new_requirement: One uniform async projection layer routing shared data and LAN_GROUP-specific business data to registered Sheet IDs
decisions.new_resource: New shared workbook + one workbook per LAN_GROUP
decisions.notes: Sheets API accepts the Drive OAuth scope. Separate spreadsheets scope is redundant when full Drive scope is already required for unattended Drive management.

decisions.legacy_implementation: Worker exchanged OWNER refresh token and called Drive API directly for folder/file/resumable upload/delete/readback
decisions.new_requirement: Google Drive is durable primary binary store under the pre-created project root
decisions.new_resource: Registered new project Drive root and registered descendants only
decisions.notes: Full Drive scope is restricted but is the reliable unattended server-side path for managing the already-created project tree without a Picker. Runtime must fail closed outside DRIVE_ROOT_ID/registered IDs.

decisions.new_requirement: Send OTP/reset messages only; no inbox read
decisions.new_resource: OWNER Gmail OAuth used by Cloud/LAN auth service

decisions.capability: Apps Script runtime / web app / deployment
decisions.legacy_implementation: Auth/OTP state, Stable Sheet bridge, web-app compatibility/fallback, script version/deployment lifecycle
decisions.notes: Keeping GAS would create an additional writer/deploy path and quota surface without an audited unique capability.

decisions.legacy_implementation: Deno Deploy / Render / Turso passive DR adapters
decisions.new_requirement: LAN Service + offline local + tested backup/restore are the approved backup path
decisions.notes: Do not provision extra cloud DR unless a future failure analysis proves LAN + backup/restore insufficient and OWNER approves the provider.

legacy_evidence: beta127-owner-r2-remediation.yml inspected: R2 means OWNER Requirement R2, not R2 Storage
decisions.legacy_implementation: No core R2 Storage dependency found
decisions.new_requirement: Google Drive is durable binary store

decisions.legacy_implementation: GITHUB_TOKEN with per-workflow contents/actions permissions; provider secrets in Actions
decisions.notes: Infra bootstrap currently needs contents:read. Workflows that intentionally commit registry/receipts may request contents:write locally. APK release permissions remain deferred.

known_cleanup_pending.reason: Older bootstrap sheets contain master-resource tabs not present in the current registry sheets. Consolidate shared-vs-group schema first, then delete only after reference/readback checks.
